# Zoho Campaigns

Manage Zoho Campaigns mailing lists, contacts, campaigns, reports, topics, tags, custom fields, and segments through the management API.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/zoho-campaigns/.

## Actions

- **Add Contacts to Mailing List**: Add between one and ten email addresses to an existing Zoho Campaigns mailing list in one request.
- **Add Mailing List and Contacts**: Create a Zoho Campaigns mailing list and optionally add up to ten email addresses in the same call.
- **Associate Tag with Contact**: Associate an existing Zoho Campaigns contact tag with one contact email address.
- **Clone Campaign**: Clone an existing campaign into a new draft with a new name and subject.
- **Count Mailing List Contacts** (read-only): Count contacts in a mailing list for one subscription, bounce, or spam status.
- **Create Campaign**: Create an email campaign draft for mailing-list or segment recipients.
- **Create Contact Field**: Create a custom contact field in Zoho Campaigns.
- **Create Tag**: Create a Zoho Campaigns contact tag with a description and color.
- **Create Topic**: Create a brand topic or brand-product topic.
- **Delete Campaign**: Permanently delete one Zoho Campaigns campaign by exact campaign key.
- **Delete Mailing List**: Permanently delete a mailing list.
- **Delete Tag**: Permanently delete one Zoho Campaigns contact tag by exact name.
- **Dissociate Tag from Contact**: Remove an existing Zoho Campaigns contact-tag association without deleting the tag or contact.
- **Get Campaign Details** (read-only): Get a campaign's status, sender, recipients, reach, and summary report data.
- **Get Campaign Report** (read-only): Get aggregate delivery, open, click, bounce, and reach metrics for one campaign.
- **Get Coupon Details** (read-only): Get a coupon's code, recipient, campaign, sent and expiry dates, and current status.
- **Get Last Campaign Report** (read-only): Get aggregate delivery, open, click, bounce, and reach metrics for the organization's most recently sent campaign.
- **Get Mailing List Details** (read-only): Get a mailing list's contact statistics, client and device breakdowns, and optionally filtered campaign details one page at a time.
- **Get Segment Details** (read-only): Get the filtering criteria and metadata for a segment in a mailing list.
- **List Campaign Recipients** (read-only): List recipients in one campaign delivery or engagement state, one page at a time.
- **List Contact Fields** (read-only): List standard and custom contact fields available to the connected Campaigns organization.
- **List Mailing List Contacts** (read-only): List contacts in a mailing list, optionally filtered by subscription or bounce status, one page at a time.
- **List Mailing Lists** (read-only): List mailing lists and their contact, ownership, segment, and status metadata one page at a time.
- **List Open Workflows** (read-only): List open custom workflows one page at a time.
- **List Recent Campaigns** (read-only): List recent campaigns filtered by lifecycle status, one page at a time.
- **List Recently Sent Campaigns** (read-only): Return up to a requested number of the most recently sent campaigns.
- **List Segment Contacts** (read-only): List contacts belonging to a Zoho Campaigns segment one page at a time.
- **List Tags** (read-only): List all Zoho Campaigns contact tags and their metadata.
- **List Topic Products** (read-only): List products available for brand-product topics one page at a time.
- **List Topics** (read-only): List subscription topics for the organization one page at a time.
- **Mark Coupon Used**: Irreversibly mark a Zoho Campaigns coupon as used.
- **Move Contact to Do-Not-Mail**: Permanently suppress one email address across the connected Zoho Campaigns organization by moving it to the Do-Not-Mail registry.
- **Schedule Campaign**: Schedule a reviewed campaign for future delivery.
- **Send Campaign**: Immediately and irreversibly send a reviewed Zoho Campaigns campaign to its entire configured audience.
- **Subscribe Contact**: Add or update one contact in a mailing list.
- **Trigger Workflow Contacts**: Add between one and 200 contacts to a Zoho Campaigns custom workflow.
- **Unsubscribe Contact**: Unsubscribe one contact from a mailing list or topic.
- **Update Mailing List**: Rename a mailing list and set its signup form visibility.
